name: Postmark
description: Postmark is a transactional email API and SMTP service built for developers, focused on fast, reliable delivery, and has delivered billions of emails since 2010.
best_for: Startups and bootstrapped founders, agencies managing client communications, developers seeking straightforward integration, and companies migrating from competitors like SendGrid, Mailgun, or Amazon SES.
features: Email API and SMTP service for flexible integration
Message Streams technology separating transactional and promotional email to protect deliverability
Prebuilt email templates for rapid deployment
Inbound email handling and webhooks for event tracking
Support for multiple languages including Node.js, Python, Ruby, PHP, and C#

alternatives.name: SendGrid
alternatives.description: An email API and SMTP service, now operated under Twilio, for transactional and marketing email at scale.
alternatives.best_for: Companies wanting a single email provider that also handles marketing campaigns, not just transactional mail.
strengths: Access to Twilio's broader communications ecosystem
